title: Divisor Key
statementMarkdown:
A containment cell responds only to a key engraved with **exactly twelve divisor runes** — that is, exactly twelve positive divisors.

**Which key opens the cell?**
hints: For $n = p^a q^b \cdots$, the divisor count is $(a+1)(b+1)\cdots$.
Factor every option — three of them fail immediately once factored.
